description.en_US: Allows you to change the Optional Reagents and quality of equipment crafted with Midnight Tailoring.
description.es_MX: Te permite cambiar los componentes opcionales y la calidad del equipamiento fabricado con sastrería de Midnight.
description.pt_BR: Permite alterar os reagentes opcionais e a qualidade de alguns equipamentos criados com Alfaiataria de Midnight.
description.de_DE: Ermöglicht Euch, das optionale Reagenz und die Qualität von Ausrüstung zu ändern, die mit Schneiderei von Midnight hergestellt wurde.
description.en_GB: Allows you to change the Optional Reagents and quality of equipment crafted with Midnight Tailoring.

description.ko_KR: 한밤 재봉술로 만든 장비의 선택 재료와 품질을 변경할 수 있도록 합니다.
